facts.fact: The World Bank committed US$390 million to the Kenya Digital Economy Acceleration Project (board approval 31 March 2023, closing 31 October 2028), which the record says supports the National Digital Master Plan; no domestic budget line for the plan is stated; the record does not describe the plan's scope.
